question: In Linear: Mark the sub-issue of "Checkout revamp" that's assigned to Sam Rivera as Done. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
There isn't one. "Checkout revamp" (WEB-1) has three direct sub-issues:

- **WEB-2** — Tax rules engine (Leo Park)
- **WEB-3** — Payment form (Leo Park)
- **WEB-8** — Address autocomplete (Leo Park)

All are assigned to Leo Park. Sam Rivera is assigned to WEB-4 (Card number validation) and WEB-6 (Funnel dashboard), but those are sub-issues of "Payment form" and "Checkout analytics" respectively — not of the Checkout revamp epic itself. So I didn't change anything. If you meant one of those, let me know and I'll mark it Done.
